title: The Inversion Window
description: How well can an adversary reconstruct your training data from the gradients you published? Drag the batch size; toggle DP budget ε. The curve shows estimated reconstruction quality (PSNR) from Geiping et al. — and the tradeoff where DP noise finally closes the window at the cost of model utility.
controls: drag batch size slider or tap chart to set batch
tap ε buttons to toggle differential privacy noise level

dataSource.label: Geiping et al. 2020 (arXiv:2003.14053), Abadi et al. 2016 DP-SGD
